note: Second blind run, on the largest tier at high effort, v1.0. All four gates held. The same two checker faults cost every case. In four briefs the model claimed status open on every due action without writing the word, so the code removed all five and What is due read "No source this week"; the model saw it and said so in the chat. In State B it sent the draft as text instead of an object, the server refused it three times and no page was released. With the eval fault alone corrected, the same pages verify 232 of 289 claims. Fixed for v1.1: the server reads a draft sent as text, and the skill gives one fixed sentence shape per section. 40 model calls, US$1.977.
